name: GeoTIFF imagery
description: GeoTIFF and Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF images as globe imagery. describe reads the header (classic or BigTIFF, either byte order) into one SDS $GDI (format, EPSG:4326 footprint, source EPSG) and a level table; render draws a window given in EPSG:4326 as RGBA from the coarsest level at least as fine as the window's pixels, through the file's projection (EPSG:4326, Web Mercator 3857, UTM on WGS84 or GRS80). Compression none, LZW, PackBits, DEFLATE (miniz) and JPEG with JPEGTables (stb_image); 8-, 16- and 32-bit integer and 32-bit float samples with the horizontal and floating-point predictors; gray, RGB, YCbCr-in-JPEG and palette images; alpha bands, internal masks and GDAL no-data. Both methods read only the byte ranges the caller gives and name the ones they still need.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic decoding of one window per call: TIFF structure, chunk decompression and closed-form per-pixel projection over at most 4096 x 4096 output pixels. No host calls, threads or network access; a caller draws tiles concurrently with separate instances.

inputPorts.description: The GeoTIFF's bytes the caller has: a size-prefixed SDS $NCD descriptor (SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH, when stated, is the whole file's size), then [u32le count] and per range [u64le offset][u32le length][bytes]. A Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF starts with its header range; the method names any other range it needs on port "need".

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $NCD envelope with the file's byte ranges appended to the frame.

outputPorts.description: Size-prefixed SDS $GDI: FORMAT GEOTIFF, FILESIZE from the descriptor, REGION_GEO_JSON the footprint polygon in EPSG:4326 (64 points along the image's edges), REGION_SRID 4326, KEYWORDS the source EPSG code, NOTES the size, bands, sample type, compression and level count.

float64 little-endian: [1, levelCount, epsg, bands, bits, sampleFormat, photometric, compression, west, south, east, north, maxLevel, stretched, width, height] then per level, finest first, [width, height, chunkWidth, chunkHeight, chunks]. The bounds are the footprint's EPSG:4326 box; maxLevel is the finest level of a 256-pixel geographic tiling (level 0: two tiles) the image's resolution fills; stretched is 1 when samples are not 8-bit and draw through a stretch.

wildcardJustification.detail: float64 little-endian: [1, levelCount, epsg, bands, bits, sampleFormat, photometric, compression, west, south, east, north, maxLevel, stretched, width, height] then per level, finest first, [width, height, chunkWidth, chunkHeight, chunks]. The bounds are the footprint's EPSG:4326 box; maxLevel is the finest level of a 256-pixel geographic tiling (level 0: two tiles) the image's resolution fills; stretched is 1 when samples are not 8-bit and draw through a stretch.

outputPorts.description: Byte ranges of the file the call needs and was not given, float64 little-endian (offset, length) pairs, merged; the caller fetches them and calls again with them added. Present only when ranges are missing, and then the only output.

wildcardJustification.detail: float64 little-endian, 16 values: [1, level (-1: automatic, the coarsest at least as fine as the window's pixels), west, south, east, north (degrees, EPSG:4326), width, height (1-4096), lo0, hi0, lo1, hi1, lo2, hi2 (stretch per band; NaN: 2-98 % of the window's samples), 0, 0].

outputPorts.description: The window as 8-bit RGBA, width x height x 4 bytes, rows north to south, nearest-neighbour resampled through the file's projection; outside the image, at no-data and under a mask, alpha 0.
